name: Green Pin Bow Shackle BN
desc: Green Pin® bow (anchor) shackle with safety bolt, nut and split cotter pin — for permanent or long-term connections where the pin must not turn. Bow and pin forged in high-tensile steel, grade 6, quenched and tempered, minimum breaking load 6× WLL. Hot-dipped galvanized, rated −40°C to +200°C. Made to ISO 2415 and EN 13889, meeting US Fed. Spec. RR-C-271 Type IVA Class 3; from 2 t upward it complies with ASME B30.26. DNV 2.7-1 offshore certification available. WLL 0.5–85 t.
